cands.name: Linda Chaney
cands.bio: Republican state representative (HD 69 2020-2022, HD 61 since 2022). B.S. mass communication, USF. Marketing and business development; co-founded an independent mammography business later acquired by AdventHealth. St. Pete Beach City Commission 2007-2009.
cands.local_ties: Born in New York, moved to Florida in 1982 (Wikipedia). Former St. Pete Beach city commissioner; listed as St. Pete Beach-based. Married to William 'Bill' Yovic.

record.text: House roles listed: Vice Chair, Rules Committee; Vice Chair, Infrastructure & Tourism Appropriations Subcommittee; member of Appropriations and Infrastructure Strategies; St. Pete Beach City Commission 2007-2009.

cands.gaps: No 2026 endorsement or money reporting found; no controversies found in sources read (not a clean-record claim). Owner-source search not run (search budget exhausted).
